items.name: stripe-webhook-handler
items.title: defineStripeWebhookHandler
items.description: Typed Stripe webhook router. Verifies the signature via stripe.webhooks.constructEvent, dispatches by event.type, persists processed event ids for idempotency. Returns 5xx on handler error so Stripe retries.

items.name: billing-portal
items.title: createBillingPortalSession + defineBillingPortalRoute
items.description: Bounce users into Stripe's hosted Customer Portal — they manage subscriptions, payment methods, download invoices, no in-app billing UI required. Includes a route-handler factory.
